_doc: BG.W-TOKEN-MANIFEST allowlist — a token that scans as zero-live-channel but is DELIBERATELY kept must appear here with a one-line rationale (a gate-detection marker, a reserved public-API token consumers set, a dynamic read the scanner cannot see). Everything NOT here that scans dead is accretion and FAILS proof:token-manifest. This allowlist is EMPTY on the wave that lands the gate — the ~39 genuinely-dead tokens are the born-RED set the F2.2 dead-token sweep (BG.W-GLASS-BASIS-CONSOLIDATE) DELETES (not allowlists). A future dead token is added here ONLY with a rationale, never a silent bulk-suppress.
